description_en: Queries metatables based on specific conditions
description_zh: 该接口用于根据条件搜索表
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public search-meta-tables --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --app-guid odps.engine_name --keyword test --entity-type 0 --cluster-id abc --data-source-type emr --schema default --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMetaTables

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.
parameters.description_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The GUID of the workspace where the metatables reside.
parameters.description_zh: 表所在工作空间的标识。
parameters.help_en: The GUID of the workspace where the metatables reside
parameters.help_zh: 表所在工作空间的标识
parameters.name: app_guid

parameters.description_en: The keyword based on which metatables are queried. During the query, the system tokenizes the names of metatables and matches the names with the keyword. If no name is matched, the value null is returned. By default, the system uses underscores (\_) to tokenize the names.
parameters.description_zh: 关键字采用分词匹配算法搜索表名，如果没有匹配的字段则返回空值。默认按照下划线分词搜索。
parameters.help_en: The keyword based on which metatables are queried. During the query, the system tokenizes the names of metatables and matches the names with the keyword. If no name is matched, the value null is returned. By default, the system uses underscores (\_) to tokenize the names
parameters.help_zh: 关键字采用分词匹配算法搜索表名，如果没有匹配的字段则返回空值。默认按照下划线分词搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.description_en: The type of the metatables. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates that tables are queried. The value 1 indicates that views are queried. If you do not configure this parameter, all types of metatables are queried.
parameters.description_zh: 表的类型：0表示table，1表示view。如果不填，则默认搜索全部类型。
parameters.help_en: The type of the metatables. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates that tables are queried. The value 1 indicates that views are queried. If you do not configure this parameter, all types of metatables are queried
parameters.help_zh: 表的类型：0表示table，1表示view。如果不填，则默认搜索全部类型
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the EMR cluster. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can log on to the [EMR console](https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou) to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
EMR集群的ID，仅当数据类型为EMR时，需要配置该参数。
